# Rackets Academy

> Padel, pickleball and tennis club with two locations in Valais, Switzerland: Salgesch (padel, pickleball, tennis) and Sion (padel). Court booking, coaching for kids and adults, events, racket shop, spa and bar. Website in English, French and German.

## Key facts
- Locations: Littenstrasse 30, 3970 Salgesch · Route de Préjeux 16, 1950 Sion
- Opening hours: daily 07:00–23:30
- Court booking: online via Playtomic (live availability for both locations)
- Coaching: group courses for kids and adults from CHF 19 per session; private lessons from CHF 55 per person
- Beginner course: every Saturday at 10:00, bookable on Playtomic
- Racket shop: official reseller of Babolat, Wilson and Siux. Any racket can be tested for CHF 10; the fee is credited when you buy. Pick-up in Salgesch or Sion.
- Gift vouchers: CHF 20 per voucher (one evening game), valid without time limit, bought online
- Membership: RACKETS+ loyalty programme via WhatsApp
- Contact: phil@racketsacademy.ch · WhatsApp +41 77 278 01 15 (Salgesch) · +41 76 291 43 69 (Sion)

## Pages
- [Home](https://www.racketsacademy.ch/): overview of both locations and offers
- [Book a court](https://www.racketsacademy.ch/book.html): Playtomic booking for Salgesch and Sion
- [Courses & coaching](https://www.racketsacademy.ch/training.html): kids, adults, private lessons, prices
- [Events](https://www.racketsacademy.ch/events.html): Racketero, Rivella League, Padel & Wine, Padel & Paella, Swiss Tennis tournaments
- [Shop](https://www.racketsacademy.ch/shop.html): gift vouchers and padel rackets (one page per racket under /rackets/)
- [Ski & Padel weekends](https://www.racketsacademy.ch/ski-and-padel.html): all-inclusive Ski & Padel weekends in Salgesch, Valais (Switzerland), 18–21 and 25–28 Feb 2027; skiing in Crans-Montana, padel, spa, lodging, breakfast and dinner; solo 1199 CHF, group of 4 999 CHF per person; bookable online
- [Spa](https://www.racketsacademy.ch/spa-and-sauna.html): sauna, hammam and jacuzzi
- [Companies](https://www.racketsacademy.ch/company.html): corporate discount and company events
- [Membership](https://www.racketsacademy.ch/rackets-plus.html): RACKETS+
- [About](https://www.racketsacademy.ch/about.html): team and story
- French: https://www.racketsacademy.ch/fr/ · German: https://www.racketsacademy.ch/de/
